name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.71-beta “Paris” (build 80): a safer start, and the fixes of 0.9.71.
• A window that stays black: where Windows can't draw LitArbi's see-through background, LitArbi now notices and draws a solid one. If a start fails, a message says so and names the log folder. This may not cure every case: if it still happens to you, please report it.
• LitArbi Safe Start starts LitArbi once without the graphics card and without see-through effects. LitArbi Report a Bug opens the bug report on its own. The installer adds both to the Start menu; after an update from within LitArbi, start LitArbi.exe with --safe-start or --report.
• Clients & Matters now has Report a Bug and Settings.
• LitArbi for Word: LitArbi no longer installs the ribbon template afresh where LitArbi for Word replaces it.
• Brazilian Portuguese joins LitArbi's languages.
• Cover pages before each exhibit: a Cover Pages step when you build a bundle.
• A citation link that starts LitArbi opens its matter once Clients & Matters has come up.
• Awards and decisions are read from their cover page only: the whole title, the normalised case number, the full tribunal and the right date.
• “Exhibit C-12”, pinpoints, “No. 3”, “4 May 2021” and submissions cited by name no longer break across a line. The first Update Exhibits from Brief rewrites each citation once.
• Update Exhibits from Brief no longer numbers a submission that is cited by name, and it skips a closed document Word never saved. Untitled documents (“Document1”) are no longer remembered as a matter's submissions.
• Search and lists: a hit in an attachment or a note lists its exhibit; search reacts to pasted and dictated text; Find & Replace in Titles works over the whole list; Ctrl+A selects every exhibit wherever the focus is.
Windows 10 (1809) or later, x64 or ARM64.
